mapper.select: select inspection_subject_id as inspectionSubjectId, inspection_subject_name as inspectionSubjectName, inspection_subject_type as inspectionSubjectType, inspection_subject_owner as inspectionSubjectOwner, inspection_query_mode as inspectionQueryMode, view_id as viewId, view_name as viewName from ssm_inspection_cfg where inspection_query_mode = #{queryMode}
select count(1) as cnt from ssm_inspection_cfg where view_id = #{viewId}
mapper.insert: insert into ssm_inspection_cfg ( inspection_subject_id, inspection_subject_name, inspection_subject_type, inspection_subject_owner, inspection_query_mode, pkid, created_time, created_by, view_id, view_name ) values ( #{inspectionSubjectId}, #{inspectionSubjectName}, #{inspectionSubjectType}, #{inspectionSubjectOwner}, #{inspectionQueryMode}, md5(uuid()), now(), 'sys', #{viewId}, #{viewName} )
